name: Banana

pros.title: very practical everyday fruit
pros.explanation: Cheap, portable, and easy to use, which matters for a fruit people actually eat often.

pros.title: often easy to tolerate
pros.explanation: A practical plus for many people compared with harsher foods.

pros.title: easy whole-food sweet swap
pros.explanation: Useful when you want something sweet that still feels like real food.

cons.title: sweet format can stack up fast
cons.explanation: Small-looking portions can still push a meal away from the cleaner use case.

cons.title: fullness payoff is weaker than expected
cons.explanation: It may need a fuller plate around it to feel satisfying.

cons.title: staple role needs portion context
cons.explanation: It works best when the rest of the meal keeps it grounded.
